narrative.northStar: Elite brown-gold learning workspace; reference landing and studio history retained
narrative.overview:
**Current live extension — 10 October 2026.** The current `/courses` route inherits the existing Elite Playfair Display headings, Inter text, brown-gold palette, logo, controls and light surfaces. It is a real public catalog of active classes explicitly opted into listing, with actual search/filter results and loading, retry and empty states. Listing does not enroll a learner or grant class access. This extends the existing public Elite system; it introduces no new palette, font family, assets or commercial identity.

The latest user confirmation extends the Elite brown-gold direction to `/login` and every role in `/learn`, superseding the prior MIS blue-and-white palette. The workspace retains Operate mode, Be Vietnam Pro, a clear sidebar, compact controls and operational tables. Warm paper, white work surfaces, brown-gold actions and pale selected navigation express the public identity without importing marketing typography into academic tasks. Login is a focused single-column credential form; its descriptive role panel has been removed. The shared `edu-*` source tokens live in `src/styles/education-tokens.css`; existing `mis-*` and `lp-*` roles resolve to these warm values. No new raster assets, fonts or dependencies are introduced.

Role-specific account and academic data persist through the independent server. Audio attachments, supported-browser Speaking recording and authorized manual Zoom joining are available. Speaking AI, vocabulary AI practice, transactional email/reminders and automatic Zoom creation remain unconfigured requirements. PRODUCT.md owns persistence, permissions and acceptance; this visual record does not establish full-core acceptance or production deployment.

**Historical review evidence.** Earlier screenshots and verdicts describe the blue portal or browser-only demonstration that existed when they were produced. They do not certify the current brown-gold redesign. The current tokens, route descriptions and components below describe the live implementation; the retained studio record stays scoped to `/studio-demo`.

**Current brown-gold visual verdict — 10 October 2026: ship.** The fresh review in `.impeccable/review/gold-finish-review.md` opened seven current desktop/mobile captures for login, admin, assistant and student surfaces and found no material fixes in that packet or sampled source. The single detector artifact, `.local/portal/gold-detector.json`, records 46 advisories and no blockers; no second detector was run. This verdict covers visual refinement only. It does not certify unseen states, replace runtime checks, imply production deployment or complete the remaining AI, transactional email/reminders and automatic Zoom requirements.

The landing at `/`, `/vi` and `/en` follows the user-selected Elite Pathway Education reference. Its original logo and photography, warm brown-gold accents, light surfaces, Playfair Display headings and Inter text define this route's visual system. The `elite-*` tokens are extracted from `src/styles/elite.css`; landing display typography and component geometry remain scoped to these public routes. This is a source-pinned reproduction, not an approved commercial identity for Project_L.

The portal keeps the established role-based management structure while adopting the warm palette selected in the latest request. Native sign-in and the authenticated workspace share the education tokens. The public catalog now inherits Elite headings, body type and controls; only `/studio-demo` keeps the old studio blue foundation. The studio-specific preview, typography and contact patterns remain a descriptive record of that fictional demonstration, not a commercial identity.

The source-pinned landing and earlier sample were implemented through code. No standing comp-first/code-first preference has been approved. The language-learning purpose and current routes are confirmed; audience, real offerings, commercial identity, production backend, hosting and browser support remain open in PRODUCT.md. Reference credentials, numbers and testimonials are not independently verified Project_L evidence. Local logo, photographs and Vietnamese/Latin font subsets are held under `public/elite-reference`; REFERENCE-ASSETS.md records their source. The eight delivered JPEG assets passed the provenance scan. Native `/login` reuses the existing `public/elite-reference/logo.svg` with that reference provenance; the portal sidebar and mobile header reuse the same existing logo. The login and portal redesign introduces no raster assets.

Elite landing finish review disposition: **ship**, with no remaining fixes from its bounded review. Evidence is recorded in `.impeccable/review/elite-desktop.png`, `elite-mobile.png`, `elite-actual.png`, `elite-preview.png` and `elite-mobile-courses.png`.

Earlier MIS portal shell and native login finish review disposition: **ship** for that local frontend increment, recorded in `.impeccable/review/mis-finish-review.md`. The bounded confirmation resolved the academic search, date and select controls by applying the shared MIS field treatment; refreshed `mis-attendance-desktop.png` and `mis-attendance-mobile.png` confirm the correction. Evidence under `.impeccable/review` includes `mis-login-desktop.png`, `mis-login-mobile.png`, `mis-student-desktop.png`, `mis-student-mobile.png`, `mis-teacher-desktop.png`, `mis-admin-desktop.png`, `mis-assistant-desktop.png`, `mis-assistant-mobile.png`, `mis-menu-mobile.png`, `mis-schedule-desktop.png`, `mis-schedule-mobile.png`, `mis-writing-mobile.png`, `mis-user-desktop.png` and `mis-delivery.png`. The detector ran once against the preceding design record and recorded 109 advisories with zero primary findings in `mis-detector.json`; those findings were review inputs, not a visual acceptance score. This earlier verdict does not cover the subsequent assignment submission/review workflow or establish production readiness or completion of the full learning platform.

Assignment workflow finish review disposition: **ship** within the six-capture packet and sampled changed source, recorded in `.impeccable/review/workflow-finish-review.md`. The packet contains `workflow-review-desktop.png`, `workflow-review-mobile.png`, `workflow-results-desktop.png`, `workflow-results-mobile.png`, `workflow-assignments-mobile.png` and `workflow-assistant-mobile.png`. It confirms the incumbent MIS hierarchy, submitted-answer/feedback pairing, revision history, visible demo scope and mobile stacking with contained table scrolling. The single detector run in `workflow-detector.json` identified a side accent border, corrected to an ordinary top divider, plus 25 legacy or semantic color/type advisories; no second detector was run. No material fixes remain in the reviewed packet. No separate quality-bar card was supplied, so this verdict makes no card-relative ceiling claim. The existing MIS tokens and `.impeccable/design.json` component, motion and breakpoint records were checked against the finished patterns; this workflow adds no new visual system or raster assets, and the sidecar is preserved.
keyCharacteristics: Elite landing and catalog: original assets, serif titles, Inter text and brown-gold controls.
Learning portal: warm paper, white work surfaces, Be Vietnam Pro and role-specific operational tables.
Learning portal: actual account-scoped records, written statuses, bilingual controls and clear recovery paths.
Native login: one focused credential form, visible labels and explicit loading/error feedback.
Studio: retained blue accent, large Vietnamese headline and interactive concept preview.
Shared: Phosphor icons, VI/EN support, visible focus and reduced-motion behavior.

rules.name: The Route Scope Rule
rules.body: Use Elite brown-gold on `/`, `/vi`, `/en` and `/courses`; extend the same direction through education tokens to `/login` and `/learn`. Keep Be Vietnam Pro and compact task geometry in the workspace. Landing display typography stays on public surfaces. Studio-prefixed blue and preview themes stay scoped to `/studio-demo`.

rules.name: The Preview Scope Rule
rules.body: Blue, orange, and green theme choices affect only the miniature preview. They are not alternative site-wide brand palettes.

dos: Do treat these tokens as the current route-scoped implementation record, without inferring a final commercial identity.
Do preserve Vietnamese font support, visible focus, responsive stacking, and reduced-motion behavior.
Do retain the concept caption and local-only form disclosure while these demo features remain.
Do apply the Route Scope Rule when extending any page.
Do preserve the Elite reference's supplied assets and their provenance record for this reproduction.
Do keep the Elite contact draft status explicit about the visitor's separate send action.
Do keep verified-role identity, real save/error feedback and unconfigured-service labels visible.
Do pair portal status colors with text and apply shared field styling to both direct controls and wrapped controls.
donts: Don't interpret preview theme options as alternative site-wide accents.
Don't promote the fictional studio content into approved product claims or client evidence.
Don't treat this code-led sample as a saved workflow preference or approved permanent brand.
Don't treat reproduced Elite credentials, numbers or testimonials as independently verified Project_L claims.
Don't inherit reference section-label ornament as a general design-system requirement.
Don't carry landing display typography or marketing section spacing into the portal task interface.
